product.ta-1700pc.summary: The TA 1700-PC was introduced as a computer for tax advisory practices.
product.ta-1700pc.history: Volkswagen’s 1984 report records that Triumph-Adler introduced the 1700-PC for that market alongside the general-range Alphatronic P50.
product.ta-1700pc.technical.configuratio: The system ROM is split between even and odd bytes. MAME documents two 16 KiB chips and interleaves their bytes in the BIOS region.
product.ta-1700pc.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1700pc.technical.limitations: The system ROMs are preserved and hash-checked. Original media and startup verification in BluMach remain pending.
